name: siete-centros
description: Landing page épica con scroll parallax cinematográfico para SIETE CENTROS

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const cp=(s,d)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true}).forEach(e=>{const sp=s+'/'+e.name, dp=d+'/'+e.name; e.isDirectory()?cp(sp,dp):fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp);})}; cp('dist','.'); cp('dist','docs');"
